name: Bento Feature Grid
tagline: Turn a dull feature list into a bento-box grid of tiles with tiny visuals and smooth hover motion.
youSay: /bento-grid Redesign the features section of my landing page in index.html as a bento grid
whatYouGet: A responsive bento feature section with 5–7 tiles sized by importance
CSS micro-visuals and hover motion that respect reduced-motion settings
A component in your framework (React, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Tailwind) or plain HTML/CSS
needs: Optional: Node 18+ and Chrome for a PNG export
